project.name: Impilo — Adult Medicine Domain (renal, cardiovascular, frailty, cognition, opioid, burden arithmetic)
project.description:
Pure Java 21 adult-medicine primitives shared by the clinical plane: the CKD-EPI 2021 race-free eGFR equation with KDIGO GFR categories, WHO/ISH-shaped cardiovascular risk banding, the NYHA functional classification, the Rockwood Clinical Frailty Scale, generic cognitive-screen proportion banding, oral morphine equivalence, and a composite treatment burden index.
The library owns arithmetic, never policy. It computes numbers and applies published classifications; it never decides what to do about them. Action thresholds, referral triggers, alerting and recommendations live in governed CKP content, so a ministry can change one without a code release.
No Spring, no I/O, no Jackson — every reference value is a compiled constant, so the same arithmetic runs inside a service, a batch job or an offline package and builds without a network or a container.
